promotion_policy: STABLE zawiera tylko wersje potwierdzone w testach. Nowe funkcje i poprawki najpierw trafiają do BETA.
architecture: 10.7 BETA = frozen 10.0 beta base + one clean overlay. Older beta patch chains are not loaded.

versions.label: 10.7 BETA — CLEAN REBASE
versions.notes: Clean rebase on the frozen 10.0 beta. Loads only the tested 10.0 base and one swir-clean-107.js overlay. Radar 9.7 remains untouched. Adds clear APP/GLOBAL/READY friend states and user-triggered APP synchronization, immediate Themes placement, viewport-safe MOD scrolling, clean non-neon nick colors, native Bold/Italic/Underline controls and a MIX B+I ↔ I+U mode. No automatic bulk APP synchronization is performed at startup.
